summary.tldr: Adds mental, addiction and substance use health services to the Canada Health Act’s definition of insured health services.
what_it_does: Adds mental, addictions and substance use health services to the Canada Health Act definition of insured health services.
Defines those services to include services provided in community settings.

Requires provincial health insurance plans to cover all insured health services provided by hospitals, medical practitioners or dentists, and similar or additional services where provincial law allows.
summary.background: The bill amends the Canada Health Act. The current definition of insured health services is replaced.
